objective: Sequential focused-task campaign to improve validated learning efficiency and higher-order quantitative-research capability.
process_conclusion: The durable evidence supports a concrete benefit for frontier ENUMERATION (listing distinct unresolved cells so the worker can move across signal classes) but not for frontier RANKING (highest-value selection). Frontier-first era (37263008074 onward) closed five distinct new signal classes with zero equivalent re-tests; the opportunistic era repeatedly refined one candidate (AAPL MA 20/60) across ~7 activations while explicitly following STATE.md Next-activation items. But the comparison is confounded: MA crossover was the only implemented signal class in the opportunistic era (so depth was partly forced), the prior 'queue' was already curated, execution availability differed, and there is no counterfactual. The repo's 'RETAIN (verified)' rows rest on execution-quality evidence (verdicts, verifier MATCH), not selection-quality evidence (chosen vs next-best alternative), and process-delta labels are inconsistent. Net: the ranking / comparative-advantage claim is UNRESOLVED; the enumeration benefit is real and observed.

Closed the attribution bottleneck agent_01 flagged: per-activation records now carry a selection_basis_record (compared alternatives, was_flagged_priority, realized_information_gain, selection_attribution) so a future audit can separate enumeration benefit from ranking benefit using recorded data alone. The convention is documented (LEARNING_EFFICIENCY.md), wired into the learning rules (LEARNING_STATE rule 8), and demonstrated on an existing resolved cell (R-001 = RANKING). No verdict, gate, or controller behavior was altered. Residual limitation: one example is captured (the stop condition), so the ENUMERATION side is defined but not yet shown on contrasting data (candidate P-008).
research_conclusion: Momentum cost robustness: COST_ROBUST. Lookback 3/5/10 momentum on the 10-asset collected universe, judged at zero and at the existing realistic cost model (commission $2/trade + $0.003/share + 2c/share slippage + 5bps proportional) with the coin-flip null run at the same cost model. Cell counts (30 cells): NO_EDGE_BASELINE=13, COST_ROBUST=16, COST_FRAGILE=1; of 17 zero-cost EDGE cells, 16 survive realistic costs. Cost drag per-fold median ~0.000 (mean +0.001, max +0.026) vs per-fold edge +0.05..+0.11. The single COST_FRAGILE cell (MSFT @ lookback 5) retains unchanged positive medians [+0.052, +0.072] and flips REGIME_STABLE->REGIME_DEPENDENT only via a null-dispersion threshold. Independently verified (fresh walk_forward+noise_benchmark path MATCH; classification reproduced; determinism); 168/168 regression tests pass; diagnostic confirms the cost model materially charges (AMZN commission $21,055). No signal rule was tuned, the universe was not expanded, and no leverage was introduced.

Single dataset (yf-ohlcv-universe-2009-to-2026-10-03), 10 large-cap US tickers, walk-forward IS/OOS only; no live or paper trading. This is simulation evidence, not a validated tradeable edge.

The MSFT @ lookback-5 COST_FRAGILE label is a null-dispersion threshold artifact (candidate medians unchanged/positive), not a genuine cost-induced edge loss; the strict EDGE-requires-REGIME_STABLE rule is sensitive to null dispersion.

The cost model tested is the repository's EXISTING realistic cost parameterization. A materially harsher cost model (higher bps, market-impact, short borrow cost) was NOT tested (out of scope), so COST_ROBUST is conditional on the existing cost assumptions.

The opportunistic-era baseline was itself a curated STATE.md Next-activation queue (not naive), and MA crossover was the only implemented signal class during that era, so the observed breadth-vs-depth difference is confounded with cell availability rather than selection policy.

The repository's 'RETAIN (verified)' attributions cite execution-quality evidence (decisive verdict, independent-verification MATCH) rather than selection-quality evidence (chosen cell vs next-best alternative and its realized information gain); process-delta labels are also internally inconsistent (37318950814 recorded UNVERIFIED while later cells recorded RETAIN).

The selection_attribution label (RANKING for R-001) is a qualitative judgment from the recorded fields, not an executed counterfactual; a future audit could reasonably argue R-001 is MIXED (it also added a reusable cost-sensitivity check, a capability/breadth effect).
Whether future activations actually adopt the convention is not enforced by any gate (the controller is intentionally not modified), so adoption depends on the documented rule being read.
